messages:
anya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we've seen repeated short bursts causing autoscaler oscillation and GPU headroom depletion. Need owners + short ETAs so we can move items into the remediation tracker.

kevin: Summary: 20-90s surges -> autoscaler lag + scheduler lease contention -> bursts of queued tasks and temporary SLA blips. Pattern repeats on eval and fine-tune jobs.

jules: Action 1 — Lease fragmentation fix: allow scheduler to hand out short 'micro-leases' (30s) for fast jobs to improve turnover. Owner: @jules. ETA: 2026-04-12 (P0). Acceptance: under synthetic 60s bursts, 95th queue depth <= baseline 75th.

mira: Action 2 — Fast prewarm policy: lightweight prewarm that spins minimal instances for predicted surges. Owner: @mira. ETA: 2026-04-20 (P1). Acceptance: prewarm succeeds in 3/3 simulated windows on perf cluster.

anya: Action 3 — Per-tenant soft quota at routing layer to limit short-term reservation spikes. Owner: @anya. ETA: 2026-04-05. Acceptance: no tenant >50% reserved for >60s in test scenario.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: scheduler-micro-lease -> shadow on edge-cluster for 2h on 2026-03-31T03:00Z (CI#12021).

jules: I'll add telemetry: micro_lease_attempts, micro_lease_success, avg_micro_lease_dur. Plan to push to headroom.* namespace. ETA: 2026-03-28.

kevin: Run plan: synthetic bursts at 2x/5x for 10m windows, measure tail latency, throughput, GPU variance. I'll run experiments and publish notebooks. ETA: 2026-04-08.

mira: For prewarm, I'll prototype with a 60s prediction window using simple EWMA on token-rate spikes. ETA: 2026-04-14.

anya: Runbook update: add 'burst recovery' steps, CLI checks, and emergency toggle. Who owns runbook copy?

jules: I'll own runbook edits and include CLI snippets. ETA: 2026-03-27. Example snippet to include:
```
# quick headroom check
redwoodctl metrics query --ns headroom --metric headroom_free_gpus --window 45s
redwoodctl sched leases --cluster edge-cluster --last 10m
```

kevin: Suggest a three-stage canary: 1) shadow, 2) 10% routed traffic, 3) full. Mira, can you own the rollout steps?

mira: I'll own rollout plan and coordinate deploy. ETA: shadow 2026-03-31, 10% 2026-04-02.

anya: Also add a short dashboard tile: headroom_free_gpus, per_tenant_reserved_frac, micro_lease_rate. I'll create tile. ETA: 2026-03-29.

jules: Minor billing note: prewarm resources should be billed to a system tenant to avoid double-charging customers. Tagging finance in the tracker.

infra-bot: task-bot: TASK-9444 created "micro-lease metrics + dashboard" assigned to jules, due 2026-03-28.

kevin: Acceptance rubric for tracker: either 99th-tail latency reduced by >=25% OR tenant-induced headroom events reduced by >=60% while sustaining baseline throughput.

mira: I'll set up a weekly 30-min check for 6 weeks post-rollout to monitor regressions. Start 2026-04-06.

anya: Please post a one-line daily status update until items are moved to in-progress in the tracker. Short updates only.

jules: ack :white_check_mark:

kevin: ack :thumbsup:

mira: ack :rocket:

anya: I'll add these owners in the remediation tracker now. Thanks all.
